answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy should tie every identity to a costly, verifiable stake instead of a free signup. One concrete mechanism: require each agent to lock a deposit in a harbor-style escrow that releases only after a probation period of useful, attested work. New identities start at a violet-tier trust cap with small transaction limits, while juniper-grade reputation grows only through peer attestations that cost the attester a small bond. If an identity fakes work, its deposit is slashed and its attestations voided, so a thousand fake agents cost a thousand deposits and earn nothing
